name: Known issues
description: Failures of scenarios tagged @known-issue=ID - already reported bugs.

name: UI element not found
description: An element or page did not appear in time: the UI changed or a locator is outdated.

name: Product defects
description: The product behaved differently from what the scenario expects.

name: Test data problems
description: The scenario could not find or create the data it needs.

name: Environment / infrastructure
description: Unavailable browser, grid or service; timeouts and refused connections.

name: Quarantined
description: Scenarios tagged @quarantined=<date>, skipped until that date.

name: Undefined or pending steps
description: Gherkin steps without a step definition, or marked pending.

name: Framework problems
description: Bugs or misconfiguration in the framework or the step code.
